title: Generative AI-Driven Full-Process Computer-Aided Design
summary: AInnovation integrated ChatCAD with Bentley software and released iPID, a product based on it, with Bentley in August 2025; iPID's efficiency gain of more than tenfold is a preliminary estimate.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AInnovation completed a minimum viable product of ChatCAD integrated with Bentley software. On 26 August 2025, AInnovation and Bentley Systems released iPID as a commercial product at a Bentley summit in Beijing. iPID converts piping and instrument diagrams stored as images into interactive digital diagrams, and AInnovation describes it as an application of ChatCAD's Image-to-CAD function. AInnovation gives a preliminary estimate that iPID raises design efficiency more than tenfold. It reports no measured result from users. Faster design and shorter product-development cycles therefore remain intended benefits.
purpose: Help designers create and revise industrial designs through generative AI.

ratings.reason: Design businesses are intended to improve design efficiency and product development.
Designers are intended to use natural-language tools more easily; no individual capability outcome is recorded.
